channel.title: Asset Lifecycle Intelligence – HxGN Spotlight
channel.description: Hexagon’s platform for original stories from opinion leaders and customers

item.title: Hexagon leadership series
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode, we sat down with Rachel Yee and Marion McCann, both from Hexagon's Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division. They discuss their career journeys, leadership perspectives, the importance of continuous learning and the value of teamwork in achieving success.

item.title: Cybersecurity – The customer viewpoint
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode, Nick Cappi, Hexagon Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division, discusses the importance of centralized asset inventory, its impact on safety, and the significance of visibility, alerting and reporting in industrial facilities.

item.title: A global HxGN SDx deployment journey
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this podcast, Brian Moura from Hexagon's Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division sits down with Carrie Knight from Cargill and Sharon Wildey from ReVisionz to discuss the successes and challenges of global HxGN SDx enterprise-wide deployment.

item.title: Digitally transforming project execution
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this podcast episode, hosted by Jay Schwartz, VP Strategy & Enablement at Hexagon's Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division, we discuss how digital transformation continues to change the way EPC companies execute complex projects. Jay is joined by Vijaykumar Mali, Digital Transformation Manager at Lamprell, and Lorne Jensen, Global Data Manager at Fluor.

item.title: Harbour Energy – Implementation of digital twins
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In our third installment of the podcast series "Digital Twins: The Gateway to Autonomous Industrial Facilities", we examine Harbour Energy's digital twin initiative - what has been achieved and how the platform is used to ensure collaborative execution of sustaining engineering projects.

item.title: Digital Twins: Promoting project performance
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Digital twins are increasingly being deployed during the project phases of the facility lifecycle. In the second episode of the podcast series "Digital Twins: The gateway to autonomous industrial facilities", created in partnership with Petroleum Economist, we discuss how the digital twin provides benefits during the project phase.

item.title: Digital Twins: The gateway to autonomous industrial facilities (Part I)
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: What is the true business value of Digital Twins? Listen to part I in the podcast series, “Digital Twins: The gateway to autonomous industrial facilities”, created in collaboration with Petroleum Economist.

item.title: Hexagon mentioned in 13 Gartner® Hype Cycle™ reports
item.dc:creator: Keri Tomsic
item.description: Check out some key insights from select 2022 Gartner Hype Cycle reports that feature Hexagon.

item.title: Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity – the vital next step in digitalisation (Part 3)
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In the third episode of our 'Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity – the vital next step in digitalisation' podcast series, we discuss the importance of choosing the right strategic cybersecurity program for critical infrastructure.

item.title: Building a stronger house: Three foundational elements for OT/ICS security
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode, Nick Cappi, Vice President of Portfolio Strategy and Enablement Cyber at Hexagon’s Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division, discusses the three foundational elements for OT/ICS security and how Hexagon solutions can help to protect against cyber threats.
